name: sampled_sowing_date_adaptation_support_sensitivity

panels.a: Future fixed sowing shifts under unchanged weather; own-window endpoint on both common-calendar and complete-season support; equal-GCM means and model min-max bands
panels.b: Fixed region-level leave-GCM-out choices trained separately on each support; each displayed choice agrees in all three held-GCM folds; caption gives retained cell counts
panels.c: Same complete-season-trained policy evaluated on complete-season support: affected-tissue proxy versus hot-day exposure tradeoff; equal-GCM means and min-max ranges

limitations: explicitly post-audit support-sensitivity extension; original preregistered strict analysis retained
shared-time endpoints remain available only on common-calendar support; same complete-trained policy compared across endpoints in source data
unbiased continental management inference not established
sparse regions retain unchanged sowing in the policy
model ranges are not confidence intervals
symptom-tissue proxy, not yield or a recommended agronomic practice
caption: (a) 2071–2100 SSP585 fixed sowing shifts under unchanged weather, expressed as changes in normalized affected-tissue days over each option’s own GS65–85 window. Lines show equal means of three GCMs; bands show model minima–maxima. (b) Regional leave-one-GCM-out choices trained separately on each support; each choice agrees across three folds. (c) The complete-season-trained policy evaluated on complete-season support, showing proxy changes and changes in GS65–85 days with Tmax >30°C; bars show model minima–maxima. Complete-season support requires all five options to complete in both periods and all three GCMs, retaining 1,902/1,920 draw-years, 62 cells and 99.6407% of design weight. Nonempty common-calendar support retains 1,656 draw-years, 57 cells and 77.4551%. Retained cells (common-calendar/complete-season) are Atlantic 8/8, Boreal 13/13, Continental 18/18, Mediterranean 7/9 and Steppic 9/12. Sparse Pannonian and Unassigned regions retain unchanged sowing. Complete-season support sensitivity is post-audit; common-calendar support was preregistered. The same complete-trained policy changes the proxy by −2.109 own-window and −1.882 shared-time days on strict support, and −1.891 own-window days on broader support. Model ranges are not confidence intervals. Bounded sampled-design sensitivities and descriptive thermal exposures do not establish agronomic or yield optima.
